research_conclusion: Negative: a regime-adaptive MA crossover (fast 10/30 in turbulent, slow 20/60 in calm) does not rescue a REGIME_STABLE edge on AMZN or JPM. AMZN collapses to CONSISTENT_WITH_NOISE (the regime timing removed the swing only by killing the edge); JPM stays REGIME_DEPENDENT (dispersion +0.034 vs 2x null +0.015) even with adaptive windows. Across the 10-asset universe the adaptive variant is CONSISTENT_WITH_NOISE on 5 assets, REGIME_STABLE (no edge) on 4, and REGIME_DEPENDENT only on JPM (1). A past-only volatility classifier cannot separate the good 2009-2013 turbulent regime from the bad 2022-2026 turbulent regime, so the 2009-2013 edge is not separable by volatility-regime timing and is not harvestable as a regime-contingent strategy. The MA crossover remains rejected from the evidence base.
